provisional_features.gap_summary: Explicit non-gap preserved: GitHub_API_Auth_and_Flows is explicitly authoritative for the GitHub API auth realm and names the consumer obligations that must remain routed to other owners.

provisional_features.title: Credential-store outage behavior is undefined
provisional_features.summary: The OS-only secret boundary is strong, but the contract does not specify behavior or acceptance oracles when the platform credential store is absent, locked, permission-denied, corrupted, or intermittently unavailable.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap or uncertainty: The OS-only secret boundary is strong, but the contract does not specify behavior or acceptance oracles when the platform credential store is absent, locked, permission-denied, corrupted, or intermittently unavailable.

provisional_features.title: Git and GitHub authority domains are separated
provisional_features.summary: Local Git, GitHub hosting, Copilot authorization, SSH transport credentials, and FileSafe mutation authority are deliberately separated.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Explicit non-gap preserved: Local Git, GitHub hosting, Copilot authorization, SSH transport credentials, and FileSafe mutation authority are deliberately separated.

provisional_features.title: OAuth callback security stops at loopback binding
provisional_features.summary: The callback contract constrains network binding but does not define callback authenticity, correlation, replay defense, listener lifecycle, or failure recovery.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap or uncertainty: The callback contract constrains network binding but does not define callback authenticity, correlation, replay defense, listener lifecycle, or failure recovery.

provisional_features.title: GitHub host policy is not actually selected
provisional_features.summary: The host-policy states are named, but the operative MVP policy remains conditional and the phrase 'at least' leaves the closed state set undefined.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap or uncertainty: The host-policy states are named, but the operative MVP policy remains conditional and the phrase 'at least' leaves the closed state set undefined.

provisional_features.title: Stable identity lacks lifecycle rules
provisional_features.summary: Stable account_id and credential_ref roles are clear, but their creation, uniqueness domain, rotation, revocation, deletion, merge, and tombstone transitions are not specified.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap or uncertainty: Stable account_id and credential_ref roles are clear, but their creation, uniqueness domain, rotation, revocation, deletion, merge, and tombstone transitions are not specified.

provisional_features.title: Account-switch disclosure has no testable UI contract
provisional_features.summary: The visible fields and reason categories are named, but redaction, reason-code-to-copy mapping, loading/error states, accessibility semantics, localization constraints, and UI-specific acceptance oracles are absent.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap or uncertainty: The visible fields and reason categories are named, but redaction, reason-code-to-copy mapping, loading/error states, accessibility semantics, localization constraints, and UI-specific acceptance oracles are absent.
